strings.rmbody: The Living Arkham is the web edition —interactive and available in several languages— of The Arkham Grimoire, FFG's official rules-clarification compendium for Arkham Horror: The Card Game, and of the FAQ chapter 1 (the pre-2026 notes, errata and frequently asked questions). It's a free tool created by Rincón Miskatonic, a Spanish blog about tabletop-gaming content, where you'll find scenarios, guides, resources and more free material for the game. Beyond reproducing these documents interactively, it also offers extra tools to help and expand the game.

strings.ubintro: Ultimatums are rules that make the game harder for a group of investigators; Boons, conversely, make it easier. Browse them here card by card. The text is taken from the Grimoire’s {opt} chapter (chapter 2) and, for the chapter-1 refractions, from the FAQ. Use the filter to switch between chapters. Community cards, by 5argon.
strings.ubrefsoon: Refractions are variant Ultimatums and Boons from past campaigns. They will be added soon.

strings.donatebody: We are a Spanish community that makes content for free, on a non-profit basis. If you like, you can support our work with a donation. Everything we do, today and always, will stay free: donations go entirely toward covering running costs and paying artists to improve our work. Thank you so much!

strings.landingnotice: Note: the Grimoire is updated in English first and translated into the other languages over time, so some content may take a while to reach yours. To see the very latest, check the English version. And if you have a Grimoire, FAQ or errata document you think is not on the site yet, email us at rinconmiskatonic@gmail.com and we will add it. Thank you!
